sentences.en: Episode 65, Testing on Mobile with Cobiton.
sentences.zh: 第65集，使用 Kobiton 进行移动端测试。

sentences.en: Take it away, Patrick.
sentences.zh: 开始吧，Patrick。

sentences.en: Time for our interview.
sentences.zh: 到了我们的访谈时间了。

sentences.en: We're here with Josh and Adam.
sentences.zh: 今天我们请到了 Josh 和 Adam。

sentences.en: Josh, why don't you go ahead and introduce yourself and tell us a little bit about what Cobiton is.
sentences.zh: Josh，不如你先自我介绍一下，顺便向我们简单介绍一下什么是 Kobiton。

sentences.en: Sure, yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: My name is Josh Lieberman.
sentences.zh: 我叫 Josh Lieberman。

sentences.en: I'm the president and one of the founders of a company called KMS Technology.
sentences.zh: 我是一家名为 KMS Technology 公司的总裁兼创始人之一。

sentences.en: We're a 700-person consulting firm.
sentences.zh: 我们是一家拥有 700 名员工的咨询公司。

sentences.en: And as part of our consulting firm, we use that as a platform to identify market needs with our clients and then spin out software product companies.
sentences.zh: 作为咨询业务的一部分，我们利用这个平台来识别客户的市场需求，然后孵化出软件产品公司。

sentences.en: Cobiton is one of those companies, and it's a complete mobile device cloud platform that enables developers, SMBs, and enterprises to really optimize their mobile testing
sentences.zh: Kobiton 就是其中之一，它是一个完整的移动设备云平台，能够让开发者、中小企业和大型企业真正优化他们的移动测试，

sentences.en: and giving them access to and management of both devices they own internally as well as a mobile device cloud platform that we have as well.
sentences.zh: 并让他们能够访问和管理内部拥有的设备，以及我们提供的移动设备云平台。

sentences.en: One of the keys for everybody in the audience here is we focused on making Cobiton affordable such that, you know,
sentences.zh: 对在座的各位来说，关键点之一是我们致力于让 Kobiton 变得经济实惠，这样，你知道，

sentences.en: whether you're an indie developer building an app or a large Fortune 500 company, you can optimize the use of any devices that you own internally.
sentences.zh: 无论你是开发应用的独立开发者，还是财富 500 强的大公司，你都可以优化利用你们内部拥有的任何设备。

sentences.en: And at the same time, where you need to flex and try out different devices outside of those that you own, have access to our lab as well.
sentences.zh: 同时，当你需要灵活变通，尝试使用自己设备之外的其他设备时，也可以访问我们的实验室。

sentences.en: Awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And then we also have Adam.
sentences.zh: 还有 Adam 也来了。

sentences.en: Adam, why don't you tell us a little bit about yourself?
sentences.zh: Adam，不如你也简单介绍一下自己？

sentences.en: Hey, guys.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: My name is Adam Satterfield.
sentences.zh: 我叫 Adam Satterfield。

sentences.en: I'm currently the VP of testing at KMS Technology.
sentences.zh: 我目前是 KMS Technology 的测试副总裁。

sentences.en: I'm also a testing evangelist and consultant for Cobiton.
sentences.zh: 我同时也是 Kobiton 的测试布道者和顾问。

sentences.en: I've been in the tech world since about the late 90s.
sentences.zh: 我从 90 年代末就开始涉足科技界了。

sentences.en: I got a chance to cut my teeth on a lot of the Y2K testing that went around that time.
sentences.zh: 我有机会在那个时期参与了大量的“千年虫”（Y2K）测试工作。

sentences.en: Oh, nice.
sentences.zh: 哦，不错。

sentences.en: So definitely seen a lot come and go.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实见证了很多技术的兴衰。

sentences.en: Remember some of my earlier testing, testing on old HPUX systeMs.
sentences.zh: 还记得我早期的一些测试工作，是在旧的 HPUX 系统上进行的。

sentences.en: I'm sure a lot of the folks listening to this probably wouldn't even know what that is.
sentences.zh: 我相信很多听众可能连那是什么都不知道。

sentences.en: So I can definitely say that I've seen a lot come and go.
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对可以说，我见证了很多技术的来来去去。

sentences.en: I'm really passionate about both development and testing.
sentences.zh: 我对开发和测试都充满热情。

sentences.en: And I'm really excited to talk about mobile testing, about Cobiton, and mobile development as well.
sentences.zh: 我也非常兴奋能在这里谈论移动测试、Kobiton 以及移动开发。

sentences.en: So thank you, guys.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Very cool.
sentences.zh: 非常酷。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个时候。

sentences.en: I remember there's something wild, right?
sentences.zh: 我记得当时有些传言很疯狂，对吧？

sentences.en: Like even when the ball was going to fall at Times Square to usher in the year 2000, that all of a sudden all the lights would go out or something crazy.
sentences.zh: 比如当时代广场的球落下迎接 2000 年时，所有的灯都会突然熄灭，或者发生什么疯狂的事情。

sentences.en: All of these conspiracy theories.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的阴谋论。

sentences.en: And none of them came true because of you.
sentences.zh: 但因为你们的努力，这些都没成真。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We worked very hard day and night to make sure that all of your biases would be updated for Y2K.
sentences.zh: 我们没日没夜地努力工作，确保你们所有的系统都能为 Y2K 完成更新。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of people listening who have a background in kind of web.
sentences.zh: 有很多听众都有 Web 开发背景。

sentences.en: They've built websites.
sentences.zh: 他们构建过网站。

sentences.en: Even entry level, one of the first things you do is kind of make an HTML site and do some PHP or something like that.
sentences.zh: 即使是入门级，你做的第一件事通常也是制作一个 HTML 网站，写点 PHP 之类的。

sentences.en: And so you have kind of an idea of that development flow where you're kind of testing on web and you can test the JavaScript on your own browser and things like that.
sentences.zh: 所以你对那种开发流程有一定了解，比如在 Web 上进行测试，可以在自己的浏览器里测试 JavaScript 等等。

sentences.en: But with mobile, it's kind of different because you have this other device and you have sort of your host machine.
sentences.zh: 但移动端有点不同，因为你有另一台设备，还有你的主机。

sentences.en: You have this other device you're testing on.
sentences.zh: 你有另一台正在测试的设备。

sentences.en: So how is it kind of different than doing development on the web?
sentences.zh: 那么，这与 Web 开发有什么不同呢？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So one of the things I always like to talk about first is scope.
sentences.zh: 我总是喜欢先谈谈范围问题。

sentences.en: You know, when you think about web development and web testing, there's really only about three – don't tell the Linux folks that I'm looping all the Linux into one OS –
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你考虑 Web 开发和 Web 测试时，实际上只有大约三种——别告诉 Linux 的朋友们我把所有 Linux 都归为一种操作系统了——

sentences.en: but really only about three operating systems and about four major browsers, depending on who you ask.
sentences.zh: 但实际上只有大约三种操作系统和四种主流浏览器，取决于你问谁。

sentences.en: You know, and even looking at that, you see, you know, Chrome holds a pretty heavy share in terms of what folks are using in the market.
sentences.zh: 你知道，即使看看这些，你会发现 Chrome 在市场上占据了相当大的份额。

sentences.en: And you get a pretty big drop-off point to where usage drops off for users, what they're using for browsers.
sentences.zh: 而且用户使用的浏览器种类在某个点之后会大幅下降。

sentences.en: So you understand when you're going into the web space, you know, what your scope really is.
sentences.zh: 所以当你进入 Web 领域时，你很清楚你的范围到底是什么。

sentences.en: It's, you know, limited browsers.
sentences.zh: 就是有限的浏览器。

sentences.en: It's limited operating systeMs.
sentences.zh: 有限的操作系统。

sentences.en: And frankly, you know, we've been doing PC and desktop development and browser development and testing for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我们进行 PC、桌面和浏览器的开发与测试已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: So we've got really good tools.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有非常好的工具。

sentences.en: We have really good development environments.
sentences.zh: 我们有非常好的开发环境。

sentences.en: You know, we've got good processes around rapid deployments for those.
sentences.zh: 我们围绕这些有很好的快速部署流程。

sentences.en: When you start looking at mobile, however, it really starts to change things because now let's take a look at we've got to do some of the same type of testing on the web,
sentences.zh: 然而，当你开始关注移动端时，情况就开始发生变化了，因为现在我们必须在 Web 上做同样类型的测试，

sentences.en: but we've got to talk about devices.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须谈论设备。

sentences.en: So last time we checked, about 99% of all smartphones in the world either run Android or iOS.
sentences.zh: 上次我们统计时，世界上大约 99% 的智能手机要么运行 Android，要么运行 iOS。

sentences.en: So that may sound great.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能很棒。

sentences.en: I've only got two devices or two, you know, platforms that I really need to test on.
sentences.zh: 我只需要测试两种设备或两个平台。

sentences.en: But when you start looking into it, things get a lot bigger.
sentences.zh: 但当你深入研究时，事情就变得复杂多了。

sentences.en: Only about 70 to 76% of users are actually using the latest iOS version.
sentences.zh: 只有大约 70% 到 76% 的用户实际上在使用最新的 iOS 版本。

sentences.en: So if you build only for that version, you may be cutting out a large portion of your users on Android.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你只针对那个版本进行构建，你可能会流失掉 Android 上很大一部分用户。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's you think about it.
sentences.zh: 所以，你想想看。

sentences.en: It's like, OK, so that's about 30% of users that I may not be addressing by just testing or developing for the latest iPhone.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果我只针对最新的 iPhone 进行测试或开发，我可能会忽略掉大约 30% 的用户。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You can't just cut them out because then, you know, if one of those users happens to be, you know, a writer for the New York Times or something,
sentences.zh: 你不能直接忽略他们，因为如果其中一个用户恰好是《纽约时报》的撰稿人或者类似的人，

sentences.en: then you get completely hammered and your product gets just thrown in the gutter or something.
sentences.zh: 那你就会被彻底抨击，你的产品也会被扔进垃圾堆之类的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And you think about, you know, you've got even looking at different, you know, usage groups or age groups.
sentences.zh: 而且你还要考虑到不同的使用群体或年龄段。

sentences.en: If you're trying to develop an app, say you want to develop a game.
sentences.zh: 如果你想开发一个应用，比如你想开发一款游戏。

sentences.en: Well, then there's probably a pretty good likelihood if you're developing a game for the millennials, they've got the latest and greateSt.
sentences.zh: 那么如果你是为千禧一代开发游戏，他们很可能拥有最新最好的设备。

sentences.en: So maybe that's all you really care about is that 76%.
sentences.zh: 所以也许你只需要关心那 76% 的用户就够了。

sentences.en: But if you're developing a financial app where perhaps you've got a wider age group, then you have to pay attention to that larger, you know, that larger OS.
sentences.zh: 但如果你开发的是金融应用，受众年龄跨度更大，那么你就必须关注那个更大的操作系统分布。

sentences.en: Distribution, because if you don't, you're going to be cutting out that older age group who may not understand the upgrading or they may not be quite as tech savvy.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你不这样做，你就会流失掉那些可能不太懂升级或者不太精通技术的年长用户。

sentences.en: But they're going to be a large user of your application.
sentences.zh: 但他们会是你应用的大量用户。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: And one of the things that we've seen, especially for Android, Android, it makes everything much more complicated.
sentences.zh: 我们发现的一件事，特别是在 Android 上，Android 让一切变得复杂得多。

sentences.en: I think last count there was well over 500 different Android devices at any given time being sold by Verizon, you know, the AT&T.
sentences.zh: 我想上次统计时，Verizon 或 AT&T 等运营商在售的 Android 设备随时都有超过 500 种。

sentences.en: And what we found is that only about the largest Android platform right now only has about 30% of the overall total users on that platform.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，目前最大的 Android 平台也只占总用户数的 30% 左右。

sentences.en: And that's Nougat, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我想那是 Nougat（安卓 7.0）。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And the next one itself is only 23%.
sentences.zh: 而下一个版本本身也只有 23%。

sentences.en: So you're talking about needing to develop an app that supports maybe up to five different Android versions.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能需要开发一个支持多达五种不同 Android 版本的应用。

sentences.en: And you start getting really complex there.
sentences.zh: 这就变得非常复杂了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think with Android, too, you also have hardware diversity, like I think the hardware companies fork the OS, something like that.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得 Android 还有硬件多样性的问题，比如硬件公司会修改操作系统，类似那样。

sentences.en: Because basically I bought a tablet and I thought that I could, as an Android tablet, I thought that I could just replace the OS.
sentences.zh: 因为我买了一个平板电脑，我以为我可以，作为 Android 平板，我以为我可以更换操作系统。

sentences.en: But it turns out they, I guess they forked the OS to make it support their type of touchscreen or something.
sentences.zh: 但结果他们修改了操作系统以支持他们的触摸屏之类的。

sentences.en: But basically their version of the OS wasn't the vanilla version.
sentences.zh: 基本上他们的操作系统版本不是原生版本。

sentences.en: And if you just replace it with the Android that you could get for free, you know, the touchscreen wouldn't work.
sentences.zh: 如果你直接用免费获取的 Android 替换它，触摸屏就无法工作了。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Samsung's pretty notorious for doing this.
sentences.zh: 三星在这方面非常出名。

sentences.en: And even you add on, you start adding on carrier distributions and carrier differences as well, where they want you to upgrade at different times.
sentences.zh: 甚至你还要加上运营商的发行版和运营商之间的差异，他们希望你在不同的时间进行升级。

sentences.en: So you've got, you know, folks who have the same phone, but it works differently on AT&T than it does on Verizon.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是同款手机，在 AT&T 和 Verizon 上的工作方式也不同。

sentences.en: Oh, geez.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So that's, when you start thinking about Android, it really just, it boggles the mind at the vast array of different types of devices that you can test on.
sentences.zh: 所以当你开始考虑 Android 时，你可以测试的设备种类之多简直令人难以置信。

sentences.en: And it's not like with web, you know, you could have a sandbox with 10 different versions of Chrome running at the same time.
sentences.zh: 这不像 Web，你可以有一个沙箱同时运行 10 个不同版本的 Chrome。

sentences.en: But here you're talking about literally different OSs.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，你面对的是完全不同的操作系统。

sentences.en: So you need kind of different devices or some way to represent that.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要不同的设备，或者某种方式来模拟这种情况。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And I know Josh has got some good information for us on, you know, some of the features and functionality of Kobiton for that.
sentences.zh: 我知道 Josh 在这方面有一些关于 Kobiton 功能的好信息。

sentences.en: So, Josh, do you want to touch on that now?
sentences.zh: 那么，Josh，你想现在谈谈这个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: fundamentally what Kobiton allows you to do is sit at your computer and go through our platform and control any device plugged into the Kobiton network anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，Kobiton 允许你坐在电脑前，通过我们的平台控制世界各地连接到 Kobiton 网络的任何设备。

sentences.en: So a lot of people, as Adam talked to, need access to different types of devices to make sure that their app or their responsive website works on different types of apps.
sentences.zh: 正如 Adam 所说，很多人需要访问不同类型的设备，以确保他们的应用或响应式网站能在各种设备上正常运行。

sentences.en: So not only do we have a lab set up in Santa Clara, California, that can be accessed anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不仅在加州圣克拉拉建立了一个可以从世界各地访问的实验室。

sentences.en: It currently has approximately 200 devices there and it's growing every day.
sentences.zh: 目前那里大约有 200 台设备，而且每天都在增加。

sentences.en: But you can also plug in, let's say, you know, you're part of a company like Lockheed Martin, for example, and you've got people working all over the world.
sentences.zh: 你也可以接入设备，比如，假设你是洛克希德·马丁公司的一员，你的员工遍布世界各地。

sentences.en: You could plug in all those devices globally and have people sitting anywhere as long as they're connected to your Kobiton platform,
sentences.zh: 你可以将全球各地的设备接入进来，只要人们连接到你的 Kobiton 平台，无论身在何处，

sentences.en: access those devices and test upon them as if they were holding them and use all the features that are available within a phone.
sentences.zh: 都可以访问这些设备并进行测试，就像他们亲手拿着设备一样，并使用手机上可用的所有功能。

sentences.en: But doing that virtually, or not virtually because it's not a virtual machine, it's an actual device, but doing it through your computer.
sentences.zh: 但这是在虚拟地操作，或者说不是虚拟的，因为这不是虚拟机，而是真实的设备，只是通过你的电脑来操作。

sentences.en: Gotcha, like doing it remotely.
sentences.zh: 明白了，就像远程操作一样。

sentences.en: So how do you keep someone from just bricking the phone?
sentences.zh: 那么你们如何防止有人把手机弄坏（变砖）呢？

sentences.en: Or if they do, then I guess the phone physically exists somewhere and so a person will go out and flash it or what have you.
sentences.zh: 或者如果他们真的弄坏了，我想手机在物理上存在于某个地方，所以会有人去刷机之类的吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, let me actually answer that initially, Adam, and you can jump in if you want.
sentences.zh: 是的，让我先回答这个问题，Adam，如果你想补充随时可以。

sentences.en: That's been one of our biggest surprises and one of our biggest challenges, quite honestly,
sentences.zh: 老实说，这是我们最大的惊喜和挑战之一，

sentences.en: is the number of hackers out there who, for whatever reason, are interested in, you know, coming into our network and trying to destroy our phones.
sentences.zh: 就是有大量的黑客，无论出于什么原因，对进入我们的网络并试图破坏我们的手机感兴趣。

sentences.en: So we have lost a handful of them over the process.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个过程中我们确实损失了一些设备。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah, but fortunately, you know, we've got, you know, we've got really strong developers on our side.
sentences.zh: 是的，但幸运的是，我们这边有非常强大的开发人员。

sentences.en: And as those vulnerabilities are identified within our platform, we've, you know, we've been able to clean those up.
sentences.zh: 随着这些漏洞在我们的平台中被发现，我们已经能够清理它们了。

sentences.en: So we haven't had any issues in quite some time.
sentences.zh: 所以我们已经很久没有遇到过这种问题了。

sentences.en: But early on, while we were in the early stages of beta, that was a challenge.
sentences.zh: 但在早期，当我们处于测试阶段时，这确实是一个挑战。

sentences.en: I feel as if that's just incredibly rewarding experience that you have.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一种非常有价值的经历。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a little bit off topic, but the fact that you've hardened your system to protect against that just sounds immensely valuable,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这虽然有点跑题，但你们为了保护系统而进行的加固工作听起来非常有价值，

sentences.en: especially today when you're hearing about all of these, like, crazy zero-day exploits and things like that.
sentences.zh: 特别是在今天，你经常听到各种疯狂的零日漏洞之类的消息。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's, I mean, it's not only rewarding, but it's also necessary.
sentences.zh: 是的，这不仅有意义，而且是必要的。

sentences.en: You know, early on, we were a bit concerned that how big of an issue was this going to be.
sentences.zh: 你知道，早期我们确实有点担心这会成为多大的问题。

sentences.en: But we're very confident we have it under control now and, you know, know that we know what we're doing and can secure the devices of both ours and our clients as well.
sentences.zh: 但我们非常有信心现在已经控制住了，我们知道自己在做什么，并且能够保护我们和客户的设备。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So how do they, like, can two people share?
sentences.zh: 那么他们怎么，比如，两个人可以共享吗？

sentences.en: So if I have a set of tests and I want to run it on a bunch of devices, like, how do you sort of streamline that
sentences.zh: 如果我有一组测试，想在多台设备上运行，你们是如何简化这个流程的，

sentences.en: so that I'm not having to go and treat each device as if it's, you know, plugged into my computer and do a lot of manual labor?
sentences.zh: 这样我就不必把每台设备都当作连接到我电脑上的设备来处理，也不必做大量的手动工作？

sentences.en: Yeah, Adam, why don't you answer that?
sentences.zh: 好的，Adam，你来回答这个问题吧？

sentences.en: Sure, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 没问题，当然可以。

sentences.en: Yeah, so if you're talking on the manual side, you essentially, when you go into Cobotan,
sentences.zh: 没错，所以如果你是在手动测试方面，基本上当你进入 Cobotan 时，

sentences.en: you have the ability to reserve a device and set a device or you can even schedule that you want access to a device at XYZ time and then you get access.
sentences.zh: 你有权预留设备并进行设置，或者你甚至可以预约在某个时间点使用设备，然后你就能获得访问权限。

sentences.en: So definitely on the manual side, it is more of a one, you know, time I'm using a device at one given time.
sentences.zh: 所以毫无疑问，在手动测试方面，更多是一次性使用，你知道，我在某个特定时间使用一台设备。

sentences.en: Unless you had on-prem type devices and then you could have multiple instances of Cobotan up and running and testing through multiple devices.
sentences.zh: 除非你有本地设备，那样你就可以同时运行多个 Cobotan 实例，并通过多台设备进行测试。

sentences.en: Since it is just, you know, through the web, you would have the ability to pull up multiple and test through multiple at the same time.
sentences.zh: 因为它只是，你知道，通过网页进行，你有能力同时调出多个设备并进行测试。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: On the automation side is we're very heavily integrated with Appium functionality.
sentences.zh: 在自动化方面，我们与 Appium 功能进行了深度集成。

sentences.en: So you have the ability to go into Cobotan and get all of your device-specific information
sentences.zh: 所以你有能力进入 Cobotan 并获取所有设备特定的信息，

sentences.en: and pretty much your language of choice, your flavor, depending on what you're coding in, you know, Java, Ruby, Python, C++, whatever it might be.
sentences.zh: 以及你选择的语言，你的偏好，取决于你在用什么编程，你知道，Java、Ruby、Python、C++，无论是什么。

sentences.en: And we give you the code that you need to put into your Appium scripts so that way it knows what devices to test on.
sentences.zh: 我们为你提供放入 Appium 脚本所需的代码，这样它就知道要在哪些设备上进行测试。

sentences.en: So then you can go, and especially if it was devices that you have, all you need to do is put that into your Appium scripts,
sentences.zh: 所以你可以去操作，特别是如果你有自己的设备，你只需要把它放入你的 Appium 脚本中，

sentences.en: kick off your tests, and it knows how to connect and talk to the device within Cobotan to get your information
sentences.zh: 启动你的测试，它就知道如何连接并与 Cobotan 内的设备通信，以获取你的信息，

sentences.en: and, you know, to get your screenshots and logs and all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 以及，你知道，获取你的截图、日志和所有这类东西。

sentences.en: So we definitely built it with test automation in mind because we knew that that was going to be one of the really big rewarding features for this
sentences.zh: 所以我们绝对是在考虑测试自动化的前提下构建它的，因为我们知道这将是该产品非常重要且有价值的功能之一，

sentences.en: because one of the things that I've seen in my years of testing, and I've got a good example of this,
sentences.zh: 因为在我多年的测试经验中，我见过这种情况，我有一个很好的例子，

sentences.en: is we were, I used to work for a really large marketing company here in Atlanta, and we were in the process of testing an app that the CEO of the company wanted to roll out,
sentences.zh: 我曾经在亚特兰大一家大型营销公司工作，当时我们正在测试一款公司首席执行官想要推出的应用，

sentences.en: essentially a Christmas app that was just going to thank all of our customers for, you know, being good customers and all this kind of fun stuff.
sentences.zh: 基本上是一款圣诞应用，旨在感谢我们所有的客户，你知道，感谢他们成为好客户，以及所有这类有趣的事情。

sentences.en: And I was doing the testing on the app, and what we found was is when we loaded the app and we were using one of the more popular virtualization software,
sentences.zh: 我在对该应用进行测试，我们发现当我们加载应用并使用其中一种比较流行的虚拟化软件时，

sentences.en: is none of the images would load in the app.
sentences.zh: 应用里的图片都无法加载。

sentences.en: And having to go and then face the CEO and say, hey, by the way, this app that you really wanted on Christmas is Christmas Eve right now, and it's completely not working.
sentences.zh: 然后不得不去面对首席执行官说，嘿，顺便说一下，你非常想要的这款圣诞应用，现在已经是平安夜了，它完全无法运行。

sentences.en: Oh, geez.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: So we went and had that conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以我们去进行了那次谈话。

sentences.en: It was very painful.
sentences.zh: 非常痛苦。

sentences.en: Then, you know, with the developer and I, and then the developer was like, hey, I wonder, and pulled it up on his device, and it was working on his physical device.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我和开发人员一起，开发人员说，嘿，我想知道，然后在他的设备上打开了它，它在他的物理设备上运行正常。

sentences.en: And what we found was there was actually a bug that was ongoing in the virtualized software that was causing images to not load.
sentences.zh: 我们发现虚拟化软件中实际上存在一个持续的错误，导致图片无法加载。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: So in the simulator itself.
sentences.zh: 所以是在模拟器本身的问题。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Because when you think about, you know, what are simulators, it's essentially, you know, software that helps you test your software.
sentences.zh: 因为当你思考，你知道，什么是模拟器时，它本质上，你知道，是帮助你测试软件的软件。

sentences.en: So when you think about it is you're relying on someone to test your test suite or, you know, test your test software.
sentences.zh: 所以当你思考它时，你是在依赖某人来测试你的测试套件，或者，你知道，测试你的测试软件。

sentences.en: And when you've got that, you've got that larger potential for errors.
sentences.zh: 当你拥有这些时，你就有了更大的出错可能性。

sentences.en: And I've seen this several times throughout my career is where the virtualized software will cause artificial errors.
sentences.zh: 在我的职业生涯中，我多次见过这种情况，虚拟化软件会导致人为的错误。

sentences.en: So anytime you have the ability to test on that physical device, it greatly increases the, you know, the proper feedback you're going to get for what your users are going to see.
sentences.zh: 所以任何时候你有能力在物理设备上进行测试，这都会极大地增加，你知道，你将获得的关于用户所见内容的准确反馈。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: That makes sense.
sentences.zh: 这很有道理。

sentences.en: So over the years, have people kind of moved more towards testing on hardware devices and kind of abandoned?
sentences.zh: 那么多年来，人们是否更多地转向在硬件设备上进行测试，而放弃了其他方式？

sentences.en: I know I built an app a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 我知道我很久以前开发过一个应用。

sentences.en: And at the time, the Android emulator was just so slow.
sentences.zh: 当时，Android 模拟器实在太慢了。

sentences.en: It was just completely unusable.
sentences.zh: 它简直完全无法使用。

sentences.en: It was almost just a joke.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像个笑话。

sentences.en: I guess it was mainly for people testing hardware or something.
sentences.zh: 我想它主要是给测试硬件的人用的，或者类似的东西。

sentences.en: And so, you know, what is kind of the state of the whole emulator simulator scene now?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，现在整个模拟器环境的状态如何？

sentences.en: Like, is it usable at all?
sentences.zh: 比如，它还能用吗？

sentences.en: Is it starting to eclipse testing on real hardware?
sentences.zh: 它开始超越在真实硬件上的测试了吗？

sentences.en: Is it like kind of where is that?
sentences.zh: 它现在处于什么样的位置？

sentences.en: You know, I think from what I've seen, and we're talking with a few mobile companies, is definitely in the market, virtualization is not going to,
sentences.zh: 你知道，根据我的观察，以及我们与一些移动公司的交流，在市场上，虚拟化绝对不会，

sentences.en: ever surpass, in my opinion, testing on a true physical device.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，永远无法超越在真正的物理设备上进行测试。

sentences.en: Until the virtualized software gets to a point that it actually truly runs everything that a
sentences.zh: 除非虚拟化软件达到能够真正运行物理设备所能做的一切的地步，

sentences.en: physical device can do, everything from, you know, simulating signal strength and, you know, movement of the phone and all these various other functions that a physical device can
sentences.zh: 从，你知道，模拟信号强度，以及，你知道，手机的移动，以及物理设备能够真正做到的所有其他各种功能，

sentences.en: truly do, you're always going to be relegated to having to need a physical device.
sentences.zh: 你总是会被迫需要一台物理设备。

sentences.en: And plus, I think there's some sort of innate comfort level of I've tested this on a real device
sentences.zh: 而且，我认为有一种内在的舒适感，即我在真实设备上测试过这个，

sentences.en: and not some sort of virtualization or, you know, headless browser or whatever it might be.
sentences.zh: 而不是某种虚拟化，或者，你知道，无头浏览器，或者其他任何东西。

sentences.en: You know, I have actually seen my app that I built running on a real device that is located somewhere.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我确实见过我构建的应用在某个地方的真实设备上运行。

sentences.en: There's just a certain comfort level with that.
sentences.zh: 这确实带来了一种舒适感。

sentences.en: Yeah, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很有道理。

sentences.en: And it's also, I mean, you're never going to have a simulator that matches any one device perfectly because no one has time for that.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，你永远不会拥有一个能完美匹配任何设备的模拟器，因为没人有时间做那个。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, there's probably one simulator for all of iOS or maybe, you know, a handful, but there's not one for every combination of hardware and OS.
sentences.zh: 比如，可能有一个适用于所有 iOS 的模拟器，或者也许，你知道，几个，但没有一个能涵盖硬件和操作系统的每一种组合。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But in your case, you could actually do that.
sentences.zh: 但在你的情况下，你实际上可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, we definitely could do it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们绝对可以做到。

sentences.en: And, you know, I would say that the one area where I think that when you look at virtualization is probably with testing responsive websites.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我会说，当你审视虚拟化时，我认为它可能在测试响应式网站方面有一席之地。

sentences.en: So that's something that automation does, you know, does very well.
sentences.zh: 所以这是自动化做得非常好的地方。

sentences.en: You look at something like the Gallen framework.
sentences.zh: 你看看像 Gallen 框架这样的东西。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if you're familiar with that test automation framework.
sentences.zh: 我不确定你是否熟悉那个测试自动化框架。

sentences.en: But when you, so if we have any listeners out there that are struggling to test or validate responsive websites, definitely take a look at the Gallen framework.
sentences.zh: 但是当你，如果我们有任何听众正在努力测试或验证响应式网站，一定要看看 Gallen 框架。

sentences.en: It's G-A-L-E-N, and it's a test automation framework specifically built to test responsive websites.
sentences.zh: 它是 G-A-L-E-N，是一个专门为测试响应式网站而构建的测试自动化框架。

sentences.en: Oh, cool.
sentences.zh: 哦，酷。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's really cool.
sentences.zh: 是的，真的很酷。

sentences.en: You know, it's fun that someone actually went out there and built that and, you know, is now, you know, giving it out to the community.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有人真的去构建了它，并且，你知道，现在正在，你知道，把它提供给社区，这很有趣。

sentences.en: So, you know, where I think the testing for responsive websites can, you know, the virtualized servers can definitely help with that.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我认为虚拟化服务器在响应式网站测试方面绝对可以提供帮助。

sentences.en: But when you're looking at apps, especially all the various variety of different types of apps, you're going to want a physical device.
sentences.zh: 但当你审视应用时，特别是各种不同类型的应用，你还是会想要一台物理设备。

sentences.en: Yeah, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很有道理。

sentences.en: What about, you know, iOS is a totally closed platform versus on web, you know, every major browser is open source, like Chrome, Firefox.
sentences.zh: 那么，你知道，iOS 是一个完全封闭的平台，而网页方面，你知道，每个主流浏览器都是开源的，比如 Chrome、Firefox。

sentences.en: I guess Internet Explorer isn't open source, now that I think about it.
sentences.zh: 我想 Internet Explorer 不是开源的，现在回想起来。

sentences.en: But they're not sort of the lion's share of the market anymore.
sentences.zh: 但它们不再占据市场的大部分份额了。

sentences.en: But is that a challenge that sort of the major player, at least in the U.S., is a closed source?
sentences.zh: 但这是一个挑战吗，至少在美国，主要参与者是闭源的？

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And this is one thing that we like to tell, you know, our developers is, you know, if you want to build an iOS app, you better pony up the money to get a Mac.
sentences.zh: 这是我们喜欢告诉我们开发人员的一件事，你知道，如果你想构建一个 iOS 应用，你最好掏钱买一台 Mac。

sentences.en: Because trying to do it on a Windows box or trying to do it through some other way is just going, you're just going to be beating your head against the wall.
sentences.zh: 因为试图在 Windows 机器上做，或者试图通过其他方式做，只会让你碰壁。

sentences.en: And luckily, Apple does try to make it very easy.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，苹果确实试图让它变得非常简单。

sentences.en: So they provide some software called Xcode, which allows you to, you know, get your device's ID, and you can set your device and put it in developer mode.
sentences.zh: 所以他们提供了一些名为 Xcode 的软件，它允许你，你知道，获取设备的 ID，你可以设置你的设备并将其置于开发者模式。

sentences.en: So, and that's one of the cool things.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是很酷的事情之一。

sentences.en: When you plug an iPhone up to your laptop, you run Xcode, and it enables options on your phone that you normally don't have, which is a new feature.
sentences.zh: 当你把 iPhone 插到笔记本电脑上时，你运行 Xcode，它会启用你手机上通常没有的选项，这是一个新功能。

sentences.en: Yeah, so, and you don't get that outside of a Mac or unless you're using our software like Cobiton, where we simulate that, or where we actually run that for you.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以，你在 Mac 之外是得不到这个的，除非你使用像 Cobiton 这样的软件，我们在那里模拟它，或者我们实际上为你运行它。

sentences.en: And they also provide TestFlight.
sentences.zh: 他们还提供了 TestFlight。

sentences.en: Are you familiar with the TestFlight app?
sentences.zh: 你熟悉 TestFlight 应用吗？

sentences.en: I bet most of the users aren't familiar with it.
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌大多数用户都不熟悉它。

sentences.en: So you'd be the best person to give a description.
sentences.zh: 所以你是给出描述的最佳人选。

sentences.en: Sure, yeah.
sentences.zh: 当然，是的。

sentences.en: So TestFlight on iOS, it is a great way to get a test version of your app into multiple, multiple users' hands.
sentences.zh: 所以 iOS 上的 TestFlight，是将应用的测试版本交到多个用户手中的好方法。

sentences.en: So TestFlight essentially is when you sign up to be an Apple developer, you're given access to the TestFlight app.
sentences.zh: 所以 TestFlight 本质上是当你注册成为苹果开发者时，你就会获得访问 TestFlight 应用的权限。

sentences.en: And essentially, you send an email out to a group of users that say that you want to do your user testing for you.
sentences.zh: 本质上，你给一组用户发送一封电子邮件，说你想让他们为你进行用户测试。

sentences.en: And they all install TestFlight on their iPhones, and then you can send them another email with the link to the app,
sentences.zh: 他们都在 iPhone 上安装了 TestFlight，然后你可以给他们发送另一封带有应用链接的电子邮件，

sentences.en: and then TestFlight will read that and install the app for them.
sentences.zh: 然后 TestFlight 会读取该链接并为他们安装应用。

sentences.en: So essentially, it's a way to bypass a lot of the harshness and the rigors of the iTunes or the Apple marketplace, which has very, very rigorous standards.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，这是一种绕过 iTunes 或苹果市场严苛和繁琐要求的方法，因为它们有非常、非常严格的标准。

sentences.en: And when it comes to bug fixing, it can definitely slow things down for you.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到错误修复时，它绝对会拖慢你的进度。

sentences.en: So it's a way to bypass that to get your app in the hands of your users to get some real testing.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种绕过它，让你的应用交到用户手中进行真实测试的方法。

sentences.en: Okay, cool.
sentences.zh: 好的，酷。

sentences.en: That makes sense.
sentences.zh: 这很有道理。

sentences.en: So let's say you use Cobiton, and you've done a whole bunch of system testing and things like that,
sentences.zh: 那么假设你使用了 Cobiton，并且你已经做了大量的系统测试之类的事情，

sentences.en: and you ship the app.
sentences.zh: 然后你发布了应用。

sentences.en: What's sort of the common ways that people use to measure if, you know, maybe there's some edge case or some device configuration of yours that they didn't teSt.
sentences.zh: 人们用来衡量是否，你知道，可能存在一些他们没有测试到的边缘情况或设备配置的常用方法是什么？

sentences.en: How can people be sure that the app is really working once it's out there in the wild?
sentences.zh: 人们如何确保应用在发布到野外后真的能正常工作？

sentences.en: So from the developer side or from the tester side?
sentences.zh: 是从开发人员的角度还是测试人员的角度？

sentences.en: From the developer side.
sentences.zh: 从开发人员的角度。

sentences.en: So there's a couple of things that you can take a look at from the developer side.
sentences.zh: 所以从开发人员的角度来看，有几件事你可以关注。

sentences.en: And this is, I think, back to one of your earlier questions of what's the big difference between, you know, web testing and development and mobile testing and development.
sentences.zh: 我认为这回到了你之前的问题，即网页测试与开发和移动测试与开发之间的巨大区别是什么。

sentences.en: Well, because of the difficulties of getting your app through the marketplace and validated in the marketplace for both iOS and Android,
sentences.zh: 嗯，由于让你的应用通过市场并在 iOS 和 Android 市场上进行验证的困难，

sentences.en: you have to be rock solid that the app that you're putting out there is relatively bug and defect free.
sentences.zh: 你必须确保你发布的应用相对没有错误和缺陷。

sentences.en: And the reason for this is you only get one chance to make a really good impression.
sentences.zh: 原因是你只有一次机会给人留下非常好的印象。

sentences.en: I think the last study I saw said that only 60% of users would re-download an app after seeing a critical issue.
sentences.zh: 我想我看到的最新研究显示，只有 60% 的用户在遇到严重问题后会重新下载应用。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: And that's a steep drop.
sentences.zh: 这是一个急剧的下降。

sentences.en: And then if it came to the third time, I think it was only like 12%.
sentences.zh: 如果到了第三次，我想只有 12% 左右。

sentences.en: So that is a huge drop off.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个巨大的流失。

sentences.en: So the big change that, you know, even having to take a step back before you release it to say, okay, I truly know how my users are going to use this app.
sentences.zh: 所以巨大的变化是，你知道，甚至在发布之前退后一步说，好吧，我真正了解我的用户将如何使用这个应用。

sentences.en: I need to know what they are.
sentences.zh: 我需要知道他们是谁。

sentences.en: You know, I need to know what devices they're using.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我需要知道他们正在使用什么设备。

sentences.en: I need to know how they're going to use it.
sentences.zh: 我需要知道他们将如何使用它。

sentences.en: So you're going to have to have a very rigorous test plan and test strategy before you even go to the marketplace.
sentences.zh: 所以你在进入市场之前必须有一个非常严谨的测试计划和测试策略。

sentences.en: Because once you get there and once you release your app, there's really only a couple ways to get feedback.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦你进入市场并发布了你的应用，获得反馈的方法真的只有几种。

sentences.en: First is you can sign up for crash reports through both iOS and Android when you join their developer networks.
sentences.zh: 首先，当你加入 iOS 和 Android 的开发者网络时，你可以注册获取崩溃报告。

sentences.en: And you can see if there's a hard crash in your app.
sentences.zh: 你可以查看你的应用中是否存在严重崩溃。

sentences.en: Now, that's both good and bad if you're getting a lot of those.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你收到很多这类报告，这既是好事也是坏事。

sentences.en: And obviously, you have a lot of unhappy customers.
sentences.zh: 显然，你有很多不满意的客户。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, you won't have them for long, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你不会留住他们太久，对吧？

sentences.en: You're only going to have 12% of them in a couple days.
sentences.zh: 几天后你只会剩下 12% 的用户。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: One of the things we also like to say is reviews are forever, especially on the internet.
sentences.zh: 我们还喜欢说的一件事是，评论是永恒的，尤其是在互联网上。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 那是真的。

sentences.en: Podcast reviews, too.
sentences.zh: 播客评论也是。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's true.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是真的。

sentences.en: Isn't it the same for podcasts as well?
sentences.zh: 播客不也是一样吗？

sentences.en: Yep, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I'm sure you guys know.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以我相信你们知道。

sentences.en: I mean, if you have a really terrible podcast and it tanks your reviews, even if you've got 20 great ones after that,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你有一个非常糟糕的播客，它让你的评论跌入谷底，即使在那之后你有 20 个很棒的评论，

sentences.en: if someone comes to look and they see that you've only got two stars or three stars, they're probably going to bypass you.
sentences.zh: 如果有人来看，发现你只有两星或三星，他们可能会绕过你。

sentences.en: So, and it's the same with the app as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，应用也是一样。

sentences.en: If you release a version that has bad feedback, probably the first place you're going to hear about it is through the reviews itself.
sentences.zh: 如果你发布了一个反馈很差的版本，你可能最先听到反馈的地方就是评论本身。

sentences.en: So, you're not necessarily, unless you're running a hybrid app, and we can touch on that here in a little bit,
sentences.zh: 所以，你不一定，除非你在运行混合应用，我们稍后可以谈谈这个，

sentences.en: you're not really going to get that feedback because your app is locked within that native phone, that native OS.
sentences.zh: 你不会真正得到那种反馈，因为你的应用被锁定在那个原生手机、那个原生操作系统中。

sentences.en: So, it's hard to get a lot of feedback unless you've done a lot of communication back to the server, and then that's, like I was saying before,
sentences.zh: 所以，很难获得大量反馈，除非你做了很多与服务器的通信，然后就像我之前说的，

sentences.en: a little bit more of a hybrid app design.
sentences.zh: 那更像是一种混合应用设计。

sentences.en: Yeah, and the other thing is the reviews follow you around as well.
sentences.zh: 是的，另一件事是评论也会一直跟着你。

sentences.en: Like, your account is tied to some type of credit card or personally identifiable information, so you can't just make a new account very easily.
sentences.zh: 比如，你的账户与某种信用卡或个人身份信息绑定，所以你不能轻易创建一个新账户。

sentences.en: And you can make a new app, but your app is going to be tied to your other apps.
sentences.zh: 你可以制作一个新应用，但你的应用将与你的其他应用绑定。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, I mean, there's really no going back.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我的意思是，真的没有回头路。

sentences.en: If you make a huge blunder, it's very hard to correct for that.
sentences.zh: 如果你犯了一个巨大的错误，想要纠正它会非常困难。

sentences.en: That is a great point.
sentences.zh: 说得太对了。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: So, I guess it sounds like we covered a lot of this, but, you know, it sounds like the way to make sure that apps work the same on everyone's device, or at least we can't do that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想我们已经涵盖了很多这方面的内容，但你知道，听起来要确保应用在每个人的设备上都能以同样的方式运行，或者至少我们无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: But on 99% of your market users' devices is to get some idea of your market and do a bit of market research to try and intuit what sort of devices you should be expecting.
sentences.zh: 但在你 99% 的市场用户设备上实现这一点，方法是了解你的市场，做一点市场调研，试着直观地判断你应该预期的设备类型。

sentences.en: And then to make sure that you've tested on at least one of all of those devices.
sentences.zh: 然后确保你至少在所有这些设备中的某一种上进行了测试。

sentences.en: And for many of us, we don't have, you know, a rack full of Android phones.
sentences.zh: 对于我们许多人来说，我们并没有一整架子的安卓手机。

sentences.en: So, that's where sort of, I think, Cobiton kind of comes in, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，我想这就是 Cobiton 发挥作用的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: Josh, you want to take that one?
sentences.zh: Josh，你想回答这个问题吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: That's dead on.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: For, you know, if you do have devices and you want to share them, Cobiton can help you with that.
sentences.zh: 如果你确实有设备并想分享它们，Cobiton 可以帮你做到这一点。

sentences.en: But moreover, for those who can't afford to own their own devices and need a laundry list of devices that they can get access to in a very affordable way,
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，对于那些买不起自己的设备，又需要一份设备清单以便以非常实惠的方式获取使用权的人来说，

sentences.en: that's exactly what Cobiton is there for.
sentences.zh: 这正是 Cobiton 存在的意义。

sentences.en: One quick kind of interjection.
sentences.zh: 插一句嘴。

sentences.en: What about, like, different geographies?
sentences.zh: 那不同的地理位置呢？

sentences.en: So, in other words, I know you said different carriers can make some phones act differently.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我知道你说过不同的运营商会让一些手机表现出不同的行为。

sentences.en: What about, for example, you know, if someone's in a place where they only have 2G cell, for example, they're going to have a very different experience.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果有人身处一个只有 2G 网络的地方，他们的体验会非常不同。

sentences.en: Like, do you have a way to sort of, you know, put devices in these sort of synthetic environments where you have really poor Internet or you have, I don't know,
sentences.zh: 你们有没有办法把设备放在这种模拟环境中，比如网络非常差，或者我不知道，

sentences.en: whatever other kind of geological infrastructure issues?
sentences.zh: 或者其他任何类型的地理基础设施问题？

sentences.en: Yeah, Adam, why don't you answer that?
sentences.zh: 好的，Adam，你来回答这个问题怎么样？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, so there's some neat things you can do with some of your test frameworks to simulate some of that.
sentences.zh: 是的，你可以利用一些测试框架做一些很棒的事情来模拟其中的一些情况。

sentences.en: In fact, I was watching one of the latest Appium presentations a little while back, and they were saying that they had some abilities to, where you could simulate,
sentences.zh: 事实上，前阵子我看了最新的 Appium 演示之一，他们说他们有一些能力，你可以模拟，

sentences.en: you could take a phone and downgrade it from, you know, 4G, 3G, 2G, and, you know, mess around with some of the settings there.
sentences.zh: 你可以拿一台手机，把它从 4G 降级到 3G、2G，然后摆弄一下其中的一些设置。

sentences.en: One of the cool things I think a lot of folks don't realize is that both Android and iPhones can be set in a developer mode.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多人没有意识到的一件很酷的事情是，安卓和 iPhone 都可以设置为开发者模式。

sentences.en: The Android one is probably my favorite, is where you actually go to your settings, and you pull up the build name, and you tap on the build name seven times,
sentences.zh: 安卓的那个可能是我最喜欢的，你进入设置，找到版本号，然后连续点击版本号七次，

sentences.en: almost as if you're going to enter in a contra code or something.
sentences.zh: 简直就像你要输入什么秘籍一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, I know.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我知道。

sentences.en: This looks like how you get on the train at Harry Potter or something.
sentences.zh: 这看起来就像哈利波特里怎么上火车之类的。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: You have to stand on your head, but for real, if you tap on it seven times, you'll get a notification on your phone that says, hey, you're trying to enable developer options.
sentences.zh: 你得倒立着来，但说真的，如果你点击七次，手机上就会收到一条通知，说嘿，你正在尝试启用开发者选项。

sentences.en: Are you sure you want to do this?
sentences.zh: 你确定要这样做吗？

sentences.en: And when you do, it gives you some pretty awesome options.
sentences.zh: 当你这样做时，它会为你提供一些非常棒的选项。

sentences.en: You know, some of those you can really tweak with the phone, you know, hint, hint, you know, jailbreak and root your phones.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其中一些你可以真正地调整手机，提示一下，你知道，越狱和获取手机的 Root 权限。

sentences.en: I don't recommend trying that, but, you know, there's cool things you can do where you can really, you know,
sentences.zh: 我不建议尝试那个，但是，你知道，你可以做一些很酷的事情，你可以真正地，你知道，

sentences.en: mess with a lot of the phone settings that you don't normally have access to.
sentences.zh: 摆弄很多你通常无法访问的手机设置。

sentences.en: You know, one of those as well is pretty cool is you actually, once you do that,
sentences.zh: 你知道，其中一个也很酷的是，一旦你这样做了，

sentences.en: you can then enable USB debugging on your Android phone and then plug your Android phone into your laptop.
sentences.zh: 你就可以在安卓手机上启用 USB 调试，然后把安卓手机插到笔记本电脑上。

sentences.en: And through just a basic terminal is you can really, really hack into your phone and do a lot of awesome things on that.
sentences.zh: 通过一个基本的终端，你真的可以侵入你的手机，并在上面做很多很棒的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, actually, I had to do this, but I was completely blind following directions.
sentences.zh: 是的，其实我不得不这样做，但我完全是盲目地按照说明操作。

sentences.en: I bought a tablet.
sentences.zh: 我买了一个平板电脑。

sentences.en: This is the same tablet.
sentences.zh: 就是这个平板电脑。

sentences.en: I bought it from AliExpress, which is this website where you can get things kind of drop shipped from China.
sentences.zh: 我从全球速卖通买的，这是一个你可以从中国代发货的网站。

sentences.en: And it came with a bunch of Chinese spyware.
sentences.zh: 它自带了一堆中国间谍软件。

sentences.en: This true story.
sentences.zh: 这是真事。

sentences.en: I mean, it came pre-installed with ad-ups and a couple other Chinese spyware.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它预装了 ad-ups 和其他几个中国间谍软件。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, I had to do all of these things to sort of clean it.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我不得不做所有这些事情来清理它。

sentences.en: And, yeah, it's true.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，这是真的。

sentences.en: You feel like you're some kind of crazy wizard.
sentences.zh: 你感觉自己像个疯狂的巫师。

sentences.en: I mean, Google is, like, sending you little, you know, prompts at the bottom, like, almost there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，谷歌会在底部给你一些小提示，比如，快好了。

sentences.en: Keep tapping the button.
sentences.zh: 继续点击按钮。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a real weird thing.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真的很奇怪。

sentences.en: And one of the things we do from the Kobotan is, you know, when you're testing on the device, you get full access to use that device and the features.
sentences.zh: 我们在 Kobiton 所做的事情之一是，当你在设备上测试时，你可以完全访问并使用该设备及其功能。

sentences.en: So, you know, if you've got a specific requirement, you know, where you need to install something, for instance, that will help spoof where your maps location is,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你有特定的需求，比如你需要安装某些东西来帮助伪造你的地图位置，

sentences.en: which I've seen some folks do.
sentences.zh: 我见过有些人这样做。

sentences.en: You know, you have the ability to install whatever APKs you need to install or, you know, we support the multi-touch gestures and, you know,
sentences.zh: 你有能力安装任何你需要安装的 APK，或者我们支持多点触控手势，你知道，

sentences.en: the rapid touch and some pretty cool things.
sentences.zh: 快速点击和一些非常酷的功能。

sentences.en: So, you know, we definitely, you know, like I said before, is where we built that with a lot of the test automation in mind, you know, support a lot of those types of features.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们绝对，就像我之前说的，我们在构建它时考虑了很多测试自动化，支持很多这类功能。

sentences.en: So, you know, some of it is, you know, especially for a lot of the newer listeners who are just getting into this is, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，对于很多刚接触这个领域的新听众来说，

sentences.en: definitely take the time and research a lot about the mobile device that you're testing and developing on.
sentences.zh: 一定要花时间研究你正在测试和开发的移动设备。

sentences.en: It's not like the PC, you know, where things are relatively locked down, especially if you're on Windows and Mac,
sentences.zh: 它不像个人电脑，你知道，那里的东西相对锁定，特别是如果你在 Windows 和 Mac 上，

sentences.en: where you really just have access to a browser and maybe you can install, you know, Firebug or something to see the, you know, request and response coming back.
sentences.zh: 你真的只能访问浏览器，也许你可以安装 Firebug 之类的东西来查看返回的请求和响应。

sentences.en: Mobile is a lot richer.
sentences.zh: 移动端要丰富得多。

sentences.en: And I think that may be even why some folks are, you know, drawn to develop and test on it because you can do some pretty awesome things on, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为这可能就是为什么有些人被吸引去开发和测试它的原因，因为你可以在移动和物联网设备上做一些非常棒的事情，而你在桌面上根本做不到。

sentences.en: mobile and IoT devices that you just really don't have the capability to do on desktop.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是真的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's true.
sentences.zh: 即使在设计方面，我们也可以在网页上作弊。

sentences.en: And even on the design side, you know, like we can kind of cheat on web.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个人都有固定列的网站，网站宽度是 800 像素，然后你只是得到边距。

sentences.en: You know, almost everyone has fixed column websites where the website is, you know, 800 pixels wide and then you just get margins.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，他们可以设计出非常具体的体验，或者可能超过 800 像素，比如 1000 像素。

sentences.en: And because of that, they can design a very specific experience or maybe more than 800 pixels, maybe let's say 1,000 pixels.
sentences.zh: 他们可以设计出非常具体的体验。

sentences.en: They can design a very specific experience.
sentences.zh: 但对于移动设备，你没有那种奢侈，因为外形尺寸非常不同。

sentences.en: But for a mobile, you don't really have that luxury because the form factor is very different.
sentences.zh: 所以你还需要确保按钮不会跑到屏幕边缘，或者出现类似奇怪的情况，或者看起来不好看。

sentences.en: And so you also need to make sure that, you know, the buttons don't run off the edge of the screen or something wonky like that or maybe just doesn't look good.
sentences.zh: 看起来太拥挤了。

sentences.en: It looks too crowded.
sentences.zh: 是的，你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're exactly right.
sentences.zh: 我总是喜欢听人们说，好吧，我们有这个移动设备，让我们在各种屏幕尺寸上进行测试。

sentences.en: You know, one of the things that I always like to hear folks say is, okay, you know, we've got this mobile device and let's just test on various screen sizes.
sentences.zh: 我们总是喜欢问这些问题，我们是在谈论屏幕尺寸还是像素密度？

sentences.en: And we always like to ask the questions, are we talking screen size or are we talking pixel density?
sentences.zh: 我们是在谈论方向还是分辨率？

sentences.en: Are we talking, you know, orientation or resolution?
sentences.zh: 因为现在这一切都很重要，而以前则不然，因为你可以有一个应用程序，它在这种像素密度下显示效果很好。

sentences.en: Because all that now matters, whereas before it didn't, because you can have an app and it shows great on this level of pixel density.
sentences.zh: 但当你换到这些超热门的三星手机上时，你知道，热门，不是双关语，它们有这种惊人的像素密度。

sentences.en: But then you go to one of these super hot Samsung phones that, you know, hot, no pun intended, that, you know, have this awesome pixel density.
sentences.zh: 突然间，你的应用程序在这款漂亮的三星手机上只有它在旧手机上大小的四分之三。

sentences.en: And suddenly your app is three-fourths the size on this nice Samsung phone that it was on, you know, this other older phone.
sentences.zh: 所以你说得对，你在开发时需要考虑的事情要多得多。

sentences.en: So there's a lot more, you're right, to take into consideration when you do your development.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很有道理。

sentences.en: Yeah, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 那么是谁创建了 Cobiton？

sentences.en: So kind of who created Copaton?
sentences.zh: 这家公司的灵感来源是什么？

sentences.en: What's sort of the inspiration for the company?
sentences.zh: 我知道你说它最初是一个分支。

sentences.en: I know you said it started as kind of an offshoot.
sentences.zh: 所以谈谈你激励你想要再做一个，把这作为一个全新的公司，作为一个完全独立的努力的经历。

sentences.en: So kind of talk about, you know, your experience that inspired you to want to sort of make another, represent this as a whole other company, as a whole separate effort.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 正如我提到的，我是 KMS Technology 的创始人之一。

sentences.en: So, you know, as I mentioned, I'm one of the founders of KMS Technology.
sentences.zh: 我们现在与大约 30 家不同的软件产品公司合作，他们要求我们帮助他们构建和支持他们的软件，这通常包括移动端。

sentences.en: And we work with, I think it's around 30 different software product companies now where they ask us to help them build out and support their software, which often includes mobile.
sentences.zh: 我们在这些客户身上一直遇到的一个持续存在的问题是如何获得正确类型和正确数量的移动设备。

sentences.en: And one consistent problem that we, you know, kept experiencing with these customers was how to have access to the right types and the right number of mobile devices.
sentences.zh: 当我们与客户群交谈时，我们一直听到的是，市面上有产品，

sentences.en: And as we talked with our customer base, what we consistently heard is that there are products out there,
sentences.zh: 有平台可以让许多不同类型的移动设备可用，但它们的价格高得令人望而却步。

sentences.en: there are platforms out there that make many different types of mobile devices available, but they're prohibitively expensive.
sentences.zh: 他们根本买不起这些软件。

sentences.en: And they just couldn't afford to buy the software.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，他们会说，我们尝试过模拟器，但模拟器并不是真正的设备。

sentences.en: And on the flip side, they'd say, we've tried emulators, but emulators aren't really the real thing.
sentences.zh: 所以他们最终做的是，我们的一些客户确实有 100 台设备放在拉链袋里，充电器放在抽屉里，旁边还有一张纸，

sentences.en: So what they end up doing is, you know, some of our customers literally have 100 devices sitting in Ziploc baggies with their chargers in a drawer with a piece of paper, you know,
sentences.zh: 人们在上面登记借出和归还设备。

sentences.en: and next to it, people checking in and checking out devices.

sentences.en: And you never know what devices are charged, what operating system they're running, whether they've been swiped clean or not, who's really checked them out.

sentences.en: So, you know, one of the things that he likes to talk about, and it's so true, is if you have ideas,

sentences.en: especially in the development, because most likely there's someone who's having that same problem

sentences.en: that needs, you know, your support and your thoughts, and you can put your heads together and probably come up with a really, really good solution.

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.

sentences.en: I mean, I feel like I bring this up way too often, but I always am really interested in these, like, economic thought experiments.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我提这个提得太频繁了，但我总是对这些经济思想实验非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: And the one I like the most is the prisoner's dilemma.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的一个是囚徒困境。

sentences.en: And, you know, if you study this, you find that the prisoner's dilemma is basically there are two people, and if they work together, they each get a decent, you know, reward.
sentences.zh: 如果你研究这个，你会发现囚徒困境基本上是有两个人，如果他们合作，他们每个人都会得到一个不错的奖励。

sentences.en: They each get a decent, let's say, paycheck.
sentences.zh: 他们每个人都会得到一份不错的薪水。

sentences.en: If one person takes advantage of the other, that person gets a huge reward.
sentences.zh: 如果一个人利用另一个人，那个人会得到巨大的奖励。

sentences.en: But if they both try and take advantage of each other at the same time, no one gets anything.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们同时试图利用对方，谁也得不到任何东西。

sentences.en: And if you just do one round of this, you know, mathematicians and economists have kind of proven that you should be selfish.
sentences.zh: 如果你只做一轮，数学家和经济学家已经证明你应该自私。

sentences.en: Like, if you only have one shot at this, then you should just try and take advantage of the other person.
sentences.zh: 如果你只有一次机会，那么你应该试着利用对方。

sentences.en: And mathematically, that's going to work out the beSt.
sentences.zh: 从数学上讲，这会产生最好的结果。

sentences.en: But if you have this repeated, they call it the iterated prisoner's dilemma, where you're just
sentences.zh: 但如果你重复进行，他们称之为迭代囚徒困境，你总是发现自己处于这种境地，

sentences.en: always finding yourself in this position where, you know, helping someone else will cause you to not do as well, but still pretty good.
sentences.zh: 帮助别人会导致你做得没那么好，但仍然相当不错。

sentences.en: But you're kind of depending on each other.
sentences.zh: 但你们在某种程度上依赖于彼此。

sentences.en: If you kind of keep doing this, then what your strategy should be is to look at what the other person is doing, and if that person is helping, then you should help that person.
sentences.zh: 如果你继续这样做，那么你的策略应该是观察对方在做什么，如果那个人在帮助，那么你应该帮助那个人。

sentences.en: And if that person has a reputation for not helping, then you shouldn't help that person.
sentences.zh: 如果那个人有不帮忙的名声，那么你不应该帮助那个人。

sentences.en: And so even like, you know, I also believe that there's sort of a bit of karmic justice in the world.
sentences.zh: 所以即使，我也相信世界上有一种因果正义。

sentences.en: But even that aside, you know, there's, you should always be kind of an interest of, of kind of reaching out and connecting with people and building kind of something greater,
sentences.zh: 但撇开这一点不谈，你应该始终有一种接触和联系他人并建立更伟大事业的兴趣，
